messages:
maria: Follow-up on the sideload+chunk protocol we sketched. Capturing tradeoffs + next steps before RFC update.

tom: Short summary pls.

maria: Edge streams tokens as chunked blobs; for large responses we persist chunks to object store and hand clients resumable tokens + chunk metadata. Goal: keep edge mem small and allow efficient resume/failover.

anya: Key risks: egress spikes, tenant cost exposure, and correctness on resume if upstream model changed.

tom: Proposal knobs: inline_threshold=256KB, chunk_target=128KB, max_concurrent_sideloads_per_tenant=6, global_node_sideload_limit=64.

maria: Resume semantics: resume-token encodes upstream_digest, model_version, prompt_hash, and offset; token is signed and short-lived. Edge will only auto-resume if upstream_digest matches. Conservative default: surface resumable error instead of aggressive auto-resume.

infra-bot: Recommend presigned one-time URLs for chunk upload, store content-md5, verify on finalize. Encrypt-at-rest flag when tenant requires KMS.

anya: Backpressure: return 429 + X-Edge-Reason: sideload-backpressure when limits hit. Clients should fall back to non-sideload path or backoff.

maria: Example start response for SDKs:
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
X-Resumable-Token: rtk:eyJ...
X-Sideload-Base: https://obj.redwood/ten/abc/chunks/

Then stream metadata frames: {"chunk_id":"c-1","seq":0,"size":120000,"url":"..."}.

tom: Error codes: 429 (backpressure), 410 (token invalid/evicted), 424 (incomplete-upstream), 502/504 upstream transient.

anya: Observability: emit sideload.start, sideload.chunk.upload, sideload.finalize, sideload.fail; tag tenant, request_id, node. Add chunk_storage_bytes and chunk_egress_bytes for billing.

maria: Admission control: when node memory pressure high, reject X-Sideloader header with 503 + Retry-After. Also add per-tenant max_total_sideload_bytes to prevent runaway costs.

devx: UX ask: please include minimal SDK pseudocode for reassembly & retry; we need clear header docs.

maria: Will add. Rollout plan: P1 internal opt-in conservative-resume; P2 canary with presigned URLs; P3 GA with SDK helpers + Dedicated config.

infra-bot: JIRA created: SID-456 - sideload finalize verification.

tom: Action items: tom -> prototype egress perf (2w); infra -> presigned URL + verify (1w); devx -> header docs + examples (this sprint); anya -> config defaults + quotas (1w).

maria: Thanks all. If no objections I'll update the RFC tonight and include config knobs + error matrix.

devx: lgtm

anya: +1, also drafting threat-model note for chunk URL abuse.
